note: Authored hypothetical debugging missions. No execution, deployment, hardware or automatic grading is implied.

items.subject: go
items.title: A missing map entry
items.failure: The first visit panics: assignment to entry in nil map.
items.goal: Count visits without panicking and test the initial visit.
items.private_solution: Initialize the map before assignment; a nil map supports reads but not writes.

items.subject: go
items.title: The loop skips a record
items.failure: Input [4, 9] produces 9; the empty input produces 0.
items.goal: Include every value exactly once.
items.private_solution: The loop starts at index one.

items.subject: go
items.title: The update disappears
items.failure: The slice still contains inactive users after activate returns.
items.goal: Update the original slice without replacing its identity.
items.private_solution: The range value is a copy; update through the slice index.

items.subject: go
items.title: An unexpected empty decode
items.failure: Decoding {"name":"Ada"} leaves the field empty.
items.goal: Decode the field and surface malformed input.
items.private_solution: encoding/json ignores unexported fields; exported fields/tags and error handling are needed.

items.subject: go
items.title: A stranded sender
items.failure: The function deadlocks before it returns.
items.goal: Explain the blocking trace and fix channel coordination.
items.private_solution: An unbuffered send requires a concurrent receiver.

items.subject: go
items.title: The ignored cancellation
items.failure: Canceling ctx does not stop a slow request.
items.goal: Propagate cancellation and test with a blocked test server.
items.private_solution: The request was created without the context; also handle request creation errors.

items.subject: go
items.title: A cache under load
items.code:
var cache = map[string]int{}
func update(k string) { cache[k]++ }
items.failure: Concurrent request handlers race on the cache and may crash.
items.goal: Preserve exact counts while synchronizing all accesses.
items.private_solution: Go maps are not safe for concurrent writes; the read-modify-write needs one synchronization boundary.

items.subject: go
items.title: A producer never finishes
items.failure: The consumer exits; cancellation then leaves the producer goroutine blocked.
items.goal: Make both cancellation and blocked sends terminate promptly.
items.private_solution: Cancellation must participate in a select with the send, not only be checked before it.

items.subject: go
items.title: A typed nil crosses an interface
items.failure: run() != nil is true; logging its Error can panic.
items.goal: Return a truly nil error for success and test interface values.
items.private_solution: The error interface has a dynamic type even though its dynamic pointer is nil.

items.subject: go
items.title: A bounded worker pipeline stalls
items.failure: With multiple jobs, Wait can block forever and cancellation is not handled.
items.goal: Design bounded consumption, closure ownership, cancellation, and a leak regression test.
items.private_solution: Producers block on the full results channel before Done; consume concurrently and close after producers finish.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A fractional average
items.code: double Average(int total, int count) => total / count;
items.failure: Average(7, 2) returns 3.
items.goal: Return the fractional result and define behavior for zero count.
items.private_solution: Integer division happens before conversion to double.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: The missing key
items.code:
var scores = new Dictionary<string, int>();
Console.WriteLine(scores["Ada"]);
items.failure: Reading a player with no score throws KeyNotFoundException.
items.goal: Give missing players an explicit default without hiding other failures.
items.private_solution: The dictionary indexer requires the key to exist; use a missing-key-aware operation.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A filtered sequence changes
items.failure: The count is zero although the query was created before Clear.
items.goal: Keep a snapshot of the selected values.
items.private_solution: LINQ deferred execution observes the collection at enumeration time.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A struct update is lost
items.code:
struct Counter { public int Total; }
void Add(Counter counter) { counter.Total++; }
items.failure: The caller sees no change to Total.
items.goal: Choose and justify a value-returning or reference-passing contract.
items.private_solution: A struct is passed by value here.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: Invalid enumeration
items.failure: Removing an inactive user invalidates the List enumerator.
items.goal: Remove all inactive users without skipped entries.
items.private_solution: The collection is structurally modified during enumeration.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: An unobserved async failure
items.failure: The handler reports success before the write finishes and cannot await its failure.
items.goal: Make completion and errors observable to the caller.
items.private_solution: An async void method is unsuitable outside event handlers; propagate a Task and await it.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A disposed result stream
items.failure: ReadLater lazily enumerates after Lines returns and the reader is disposed.
items.goal: Make resource lifetime include enumeration and test early disposal.
items.private_solution: The returned lazy sequence outlives its reader; ownership must follow the iterator.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A thread-safe cache still duplicates work
items.code: var value = cache.GetOrAdd(key, _ => ChargeCard(order));
items.failure: ConcurrentDictionary remains valid, but two simultaneous requests can charge twice.
items.goal: Ensure the payment side effect has durable idempotency.
items.private_solution: GetOrAdd value factories may run more than once; dictionary safety is not exactly-once side-effect execution.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: An update is not atomic
items.failure: Two separate DbContexts load the same count and one increment is lost.
items.goal: Define a concurrency strategy, conflict handling, and a deterministic interleaving test.
items.private_solution: Read-modify-write across contexts requires optimistic concurrency or an atomic database update.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A service captures scoped state
items.failure: A singleton retains a scoped DbContext and concurrent jobs fail or share state.
items.goal: Give each job a bounded service scope and correct disposal/cancellation.
items.private_solution: A captive scoped dependency violates lifetime and DbContext thread-safety constraints.

items.subject: html
items.title: A cancel button submits
items.code:
<form action="/save" method="post">
 <input name="name">
 <button>Cancel</button>
</form>
items.failure: Clicking Cancel submits the form.
items.goal: Provide a non-submitting cancel control.
items.private_solution: A button associated with a form defaults to submit.

items.subject: html
items.title: A false boolean attribute
items.code: <button disabled="false">Continue</button>
items.failure: The button is still disabled.
items.goal: Represent the enabled state correctly.
items.private_solution: Boolean attributes are true by presence, not by their string value.

items.subject: html
items.title: A label names the wrong input
items.code:
<label for="email">Email</label>
<input id="address" type="email">
items.failure: Clicking the label does not focus the input.
items.goal: Associate the visible label with its input.
items.private_solution: The for attribute and input id do not match.

items.subject: html
items.title: A missing submission value
items.code:
<form action="/search">
 <input id="query" value="graphs">
 <button>Search</button>
</form>
items.failure: The submitted query string does not include the typed term.
items.goal: Submit the named search field.
items.private_solution: The control lacks a name; an id does not provide a submission key.

items.subject: html
items.title: Nested forms behave unexpectedly
items.code:
<form id="outer"><input name="a">
 <form id="inner"><input name="b"></form>
 <button>Save</button></form>
items.failure: Parsed form ownership differs from source indentation.
items.goal: Use valid form structure and verify the actual DOM and form ownership.
items.private_solution: Nested forms are invalid and the parser repairs markup.

items.subject: html
items.title: A required field is ignored
items.code:
<form><input name="email" required disabled>
<button>Join</button></form>
items.failure: The empty email neither validates nor appears in the submission.
items.goal: Distinguish read-only data from disabled controls.
items.private_solution: Disabled controls are excluded from validation and form submission.

items.subject: html
items.title: Keyboard users cannot activate a control
items.code: Open settings
items.failure: The control can receive focus but Enter and Space do nothing.
items.goal: Provide native keyboard activation semantics and a test.
items.private_solution: A role and tabindex alone do not implement button behavior; prefer a real button.

items.subject: html
items.title: A table caption moves in the DOM
items.code:
Monthly totals
42
items.failure: Text appears outside the table after parsing.
items.goal: Use the correct table content model and preserve the accessible caption.
items.private_solution: Raw text in a table triggers parser repair; a caption is the appropriate element.

items.subject: html
items.title: Duplicate IDs corrupt associations
items.code:
<label for="user">Account owner</label><input id="user">
<label for="user">Backup owner</label><input id="user">
items.failure: Assistive-technology and label targeting become ambiguous in repeated rows.
items.goal: Generate unique stable identifiers and test associations after reordering rows.
items.private_solution: IDs must be unique; repeated label targets attach incorrectly.

items.subject: html
items.title: A custom modal traps users outside
items.code: Confirm removal
items.failure: Tab reaches background controls and closing loses the original focus.
items.goal: Specify a complete focus, dismissal, background-inertness and accessible-name contract.
items.private_solution: aria-modal declares semantics but does not implement focus management or background inertness.

items.subject: css
items.title: A size rule never applies
items.code: .card { width: 320; }
items.failure: The card keeps its auto width.
items.goal: Apply a valid explicit width.
items.private_solution: Nonzero CSS lengths require units.

items.subject: css
items.title: The child selector misses
items.code:
.panel > .title { color: navy; }
/* DOM: panel > header > title */
items.failure: The nested heading does not get the color.
items.goal: Choose a selector that matches the intended nesting.
items.private_solution: The direct-child combinator does not match a grandchild.

items.subject: css
items.title: The flex gap overflows
items.code:
.row { display: flex; width: 300px; gap: 20px; }
.item { flex: 0 0 50%; }
items.failure: Two items plus the gap exceed the row width.
items.goal: Allocate the gap as part of the layout budget.
items.private_solution: Two 50% bases plus a gap exceed 100%; allow flexible distribution or account for the gap.

items.subject: css
items.title: A border grows the card
items.code: .card { width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 2px solid; box-sizing: content-box; }
items.failure: The outer card is 344px wide rather than 300px.
items.goal: Keep total width at 300px.
items.private_solution: Content-box excludes padding and borders from the specified width.

items.subject: css
items.title: An ellipsis never appears
items.code: .title { text-overflow: ellipsis; }
items.failure: The title remains on multiple lines and never ellipsizes.
items.goal: Provide the size, overflow and white-space conditions for one-line ellipsis.
items.private_solution: text-overflow alone does not create overflow or prevent wrapping.

items.subject: css
items.title: A sticky panel does not stick
items.code:
.viewport { overflow: auto; height: 100vh; }
.sidebar { position: sticky; }
items.failure: The sidebar scrolls away instead of sticking.
items.goal: Define the relevant scroll container and a sticky inset.
items.private_solution: Sticky positioning needs an inset and is bounded by its scroll/containing block.

items.subject: css
items.title: A dialog loses a stacking contest
items.failure: The dialog inside shell stays below the sibling overlay.
items.goal: Map stacking contexts before choosing a placement strategy.
items.private_solution: A child cannot escape its ancestor stacking context with a larger z-index.

items.subject: css
items.title: A grid refuses to shrink
items.code:
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 320px; }
.cell { white-space: nowrap; }
items.failure: A long unbroken value forces the grid wider than the viewport.
items.goal: Control min-content sizing without losing the content.
items.private_solution: The automatic minimum track/item size can prevent shrinking; consider minmax(0,1fr) and intentional overflow.

items.subject: css
items.title: A theme rule breaks its own token
items.code:
:root { --accent: var(--button); --button: var(--accent); }
.button { background: var(--accent); }
items.failure: The background becomes invalid at computed-value time.
items.goal: Remove the custom-property dependency cycle and test fallback behavior.
items.private_solution: The two custom properties form a cycle; both become invalid.

items.subject: css
items.title: A low-specificity rule still wins
items.failure: The button is red despite the later layer and ID selector.
items.goal: Explain important-layer reversal and choose a maintainable override.
items.private_solution: For important declarations the layer order reverses; earlier layers outrank later layers before specificity.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A parameter comes from the wrong place
items.failure: Posting a JSON object with name produces a validation error about a query parameter.
items.goal: Accept the intended JSON request contract.
items.private_solution: A plain scalar parameter is interpreted as a query parameter unless body handling is declared.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: An integer route rejects its identifier
items.failure: GET /items/current is rejected, but current is a supported alias in the product contract.
items.goal: Represent the alias and numeric identifier routes without ambiguity.
items.private_solution: The path parameter is validated as an int; a separate explicit alias route or different contract is needed.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A dependency is never called
items.failure: The handler receives a function object instead of the authenticated user.
items.goal: Declare dependency injection rather than using a Python default value.
items.private_solution: The function was not wrapped in Depends.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A response violates its schema
items.failure: A request that reaches the handler fails response validation.
items.goal: Satisfy the public response contract without relaxing unrelated validation.
items.private_solution: The required response field name is missing.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: One route blocks unrelated requests
items.failure: Concurrent requests stall while a report sleeps.
items.goal: Keep blocking work off the event loop and demonstrate concurrent responsiveness.
items.private_solution: A blocking sleep runs on the event-loop thread inside an async route.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Validation is bypassed by construction
items.failure: A negative quantity reaches order processing under Pydantic 2.
items.goal: Ensure untrusted request data is validated.
items.private_solution: model_construct deliberately bypasses validation.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: State leaks across requests
items.failure: One user sees another user’s events.
items.goal: Choose request-local or explicitly user-scoped storage and test isolation.
items.private_solution: Dependency caching is per request, but this factory returns the same process-global list.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Tests change the next test’s behavior
items.code:
app.dependency_overrides[current_user] = lambda: admin
response = client.get("/admin")
items.failure: A later test unexpectedly has administrator identity.
items.goal: Restore dependency overrides even when the test fails.
items.private_solution: The test modifies shared app state without a scoped cleanup/finally fixture.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A background job uses a closed resource
items.failure: A worker sometimes receives a closed or request-owned session; cleanup timing depends on the deployed version.
items.goal: Define independent job resource ownership and a version-pinned lifetime test.
items.private_solution: A background task must acquire its own session instead of retaining request dependency state.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Streaming and teardown disagree
items.failure: A deployment change causes iteration after dependency cleanup, or an open transaction persists for an unexpectedly long stream.
items.goal: Pin FastAPI/Starlette behavior, choose explicit stream/session lifetimes, and test disconnect cleanup.
items.private_solution: Yield-dependency cleanup timing has varied; the generator must own a resource whose lifetime matches iteration.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: The view returns the wrong type
items.code:
def hello(request):
    return {"message": "hello"}
items.failure: Django cannot treat the plain dictionary as a valid response.
items.goal: Return a valid JSON HTTP response.
items.private_solution: A view must return an HttpResponse-compatible object, such as JsonResponse.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: An integer converter meets a slug
items.code: urlpatterns = [path("posts/<int:pk>/", detail)]
items.failure: GET /posts/first-post/ returns 404.
items.goal: Match the URL contract used by the post links.
items.private_solution: The int converter does not match a slug.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A form saves before validation
items.failure: Invalid submissions raise or try to persist data instead of displaying field errors.
items.goal: Validate and return the bound form on failure.
items.private_solution: The view calls save before checking is_valid.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: An empty query crashes
items.failure: The first launch has no published posts and raises IndexError.
items.goal: Handle the no-result state deliberately.
items.private_solution: Indexing a possibly empty QuerySet assumes a row exists.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A detail page runs a query per row
items.failure: Listing 100 orders performs roughly 101 queries.
items.goal: Eliminate the N+1 pattern for a foreign-key relation.
items.private_solution: Fetch the customer relation with the order rows, e.g. select_related.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A user filter escapes its owner
items.failure: An authenticated user can request another user’s private note ID.
items.goal: Apply object ownership before returning the record.
items.private_solution: Authentication alone does not enforce object-level authorization; scope the query to the owner.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: Two updates overwrite each other
items.code:
counter = Counter.objects.get(pk=1)
counter.value += 1
counter.save()
items.failure: Concurrent requests lose increments.
items.goal: Make the database operation atomic and define a concurrency test.
items.private_solution: Read-modify-save in separate requests races; use an appropriate database expression or row locking.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A signal publishes too soon
items.failure: A worker sometimes cannot find the order, or sees an order from a rolled-back transaction.
items.goal: Publish only after a successful commit.
items.private_solution: post_save can run within an uncommitted transaction; use transaction.on_commit for the enqueue boundary.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A uniqueness check races
items.failure: Two transactions create reservations for the same slot.
items.goal: Enforce the invariant in the database and handle conflicts.
items.private_solution: A prior exists check does not lock a nonexistent row; a unique constraint is needed.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: External effects survive a rollback
items.code:
with transaction.atomic():
    order = Order.objects.create(owner=request.user)
    send_receipt(order)
    reserve_stock(order)  # raises
items.failure: No order remains in the database, but the receipt was sent.
items.goal: Design an idempotent post-commit/outbox flow with recovery and fault-injection tests.
items.private_solution: A database rollback cannot undo external effects; commit and delivery boundaries need a durable design.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A route never matches the expected method
items.failure: POST /login returns Method Not Allowed.
items.goal: Declare the route’s intended methods.
items.private_solution: The route defaults to GET (with related automatic methods), not POST.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A view falls through
items.failure: When ready is false Flask reports that the view did not return a valid response.
items.goal: Return a valid response on every branch.
items.private_solution: The false branch returns None.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A blueprint is missing
items.failure: The health route returns 404 from the factory-created app.
items.goal: Register the blueprint on every intended app instance.
items.private_solution: Defining a blueprint does not register it on an app.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: Configuration uses the wrong shape
items.failure: Writing a session fails because no secret key is configured.
items.goal: Load a deployment secret before serving session routes.
items.private_solution: Signed session support needs a secret key; never substitute a hard-coded production key.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A request proxy outlives its request
items.failure: The background worker raises Working outside of request context.
items.goal: Copy and validate required values before crossing the task boundary.
items.private_solution: request is a context-local proxy, not an ordinary globally available request object.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: The global database session leaks
items.failure: Concurrent requests share transaction state and errors poison subsequent requests.
items.goal: Bound session ownership to a request or job and ensure teardown.
items.private_solution: A single global session is not a request-safe transaction boundary.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: An async task disappears
items.code:
@app.get("/start")
async def start():
    asyncio.create_task(rebuild_index())
    return "started"
items.failure: Under Flask’s ordinary WSGI async-view lifecycle, the background task is canceled when the view finishes.
items.goal: Move durable background work to an independently managed worker.
items.private_solution: An async view’s event loop is not a durable task scheduler in the normal WSGI deployment.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: An extension belongs to the first app
items.code:
app = Flask(__name__)
db = SQLAlchemy(app)
def create_app(config):
    other = Flask(__name__)
    other.config.update(config)
    return other
items.failure: Tests using the second app report that the app is not registered with the extension.
items.goal: Initialize the extension consistently in the factory.
items.private_solution: The extension is bound only to a different app instance.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A streamed response loses context
items.failure: The generator runs after view return and the request proxy is unavailable.
items.goal: Define streaming context ownership and test early disconnects.
items.private_solution: Use an appropriate stream-with-context pattern or copy necessary data before iteration.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: Signed session updates are lost
items.failure: Two simultaneous requests based on the same signed cookie both return the same increment; one update is lost.
items.goal: Define authoritative server-side state and concurrent update semantics.
items.private_solution: Client-side cookie sessions are independent snapshots; signatures do not provide transactional concurrency control.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A manually created service is missing dependencies
items.failure: The service has a null dependency.
items.goal: Trace who creates the service and owns injection.
items.private_solution: Objects created directly with new are not automatically managed by Spring.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Two candidates look identical
items.failure: Context startup fails with multiple Sender candidates.
items.goal: Make the dependency selection unambiguous.
items.private_solution: Injection by type has two candidates; use an explicit qualifier or appropriate primary candidate.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: An intended bean is not registered
items.failure: Startup cannot find a Clock bean.
items.goal: Register the factory method as a bean.
items.private_solution: The method lacks @Bean.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A lifecycle callback is invisible
items.failure: connect is never called through the expected lifecycle.
items.goal: Use the appropriate managed lifecycle.
items.private_solution: The directly constructed instance is not undergoing container lifecycle callbacks.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A prototype behaves like a singleton
items.failure: Each run reuses the same Task instance in the singleton Runner.
items.goal: Obtain a fresh task for each operation.
items.private_solution: A prototype injected once is resolved once; use a provider or another explicit lookup boundary.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A field value arrives too late
items.failure: The constructor sees a null URL although the property exists.
items.goal: Make required configuration available before use.
items.private_solution: Field injection occurs after construction; constructor injection or a later lifecycle boundary is needed.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A bean depends on itself during initialization
items.code:
@Component class A { A(B b) {} }
@Component class B { B(A a) {} }
items.failure: The context cannot satisfy the constructor dependency cycle.
items.goal: Remove the architectural cycle rather than making construction order accidental.
items.private_solution: Two constructor dependencies form an unsatisfiable cycle without a redesigned boundary.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Proxy advice never runs
items.failure: Repeated external quote calls still invoke db.
items.goal: Trace the call path through or around the proxy.
items.private_solution: Self-invocation does not traverse the Spring proxy that provides caching advice.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Request data becomes singleton state
items.failure: Concurrent requests sometimes format another user’s data.
items.goal: Make shared-service state and ownership explicit and prove isolation.
items.private_solution: The singleton stores mutable request-specific state; keep it local or correctly scoped.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: An asynchronous handoff loses thread-local context
items.failure: The worker sees no authentication or the wrong inherited context under a reused thread.
items.goal: Define safe context capture/propagation and cleanup on pooled threads.
items.private_solution: Thread-local request/security context does not automatically follow arbitrary executor tasks.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A controller is outside scanning
items.failure: The app starts, but /health returns 404.
items.goal: Check component scanning boundaries.
items.private_solution: Default scanning begins at the application class package and its descendants.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A property name disagrees
items.failure: Startup cannot resolve the timeout placeholder.
items.goal: Align the property contract and inject a correctly typed value.
items.private_solution: The requested placeholder is a different property name.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A test configuration leaks into production
items.failure: Production unexpectedly uses the fake gateway.
items.goal: Constrain test-only beans to the test environment.
items.private_solution: A normally scanned configuration is not test-only just because its class name says Fake.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A runner exits before its work finishes
items.failure: A short-lived batch app reports startup completion while import failures disappear.
items.goal: Define batch completion and error propagation.
items.private_solution: Submitting work does not await it or propagate failures to the runner.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: Configuration is silently unbound
items.failure: Injecting BillingProperties fails although the properties file exists.
items.goal: Register the binding type and validate the required fields.
items.private_solution: The annotation alone does not register an arbitrary type as a bean without registration/scanning.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A unit test connects to real infrastructure
items.failure: The test unexpectedly needs the production database and network.
items.goal: Choose an appropriate test scope and explicitly replace external boundaries.
items.private_solution: A full context test loads real configuration unless the test constrains or replaces those beans.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A startup check races with readiness
items.failure: The load balancer sends traffic before the required index is available.
items.goal: Align readiness with the completion of required initialization.
items.private_solution: An asynchronously submitted warmup is not completed merely because a ready event fired.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A deployment overrides the wrong source
items.failure: Operators edit the packaged file but the feature stays enabled.
items.goal: Identify the effective property source rather than guessing from one file.
items.private_solution: Externalized configuration precedence allows the environment to override packaged defaults.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A shutdown drops queued work
items.failure: Graceful shutdown loses in-flight writes while readiness remains advertised.
items.goal: Design readiness withdrawal, bounded draining, and idempotent recovery.
items.private_solution: Abrupt interruption does not provide a drain protocol or durable work ownership.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: Multiple instances run the same scheduled job
items.failure: Two Boot instances can charge the same pending order during concurrent schedules.
items.goal: Define distributed claim/idempotency boundaries and a crash-between-steps test.
items.private_solution: A local scheduler provides no distributed exclusivity or exactly-once side effects.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A derived query names a nonexistent field
items.failure: Repository initialization reports that the property cannot be found.
items.goal: Match the query method to mapped property names.
items.private_solution: Derived query parsing uses entity properties.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A missing entity is unwrapped
items.code: User user = users.findById(id).get();
items.failure: An unknown ID throws NoSuchElementException.
items.goal: Make the missing-record contract explicit.
items.private_solution: Optional.get assumes presence.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A write query is treated as a read
items.code:
@Query("update User u set u.active = false where u.id = :id")
void deactivate(@Param("id") long id);
items.failure: The update query cannot execute through the repository method as declared.

items.subject: typescript

items.goal: Design a request-version ownership check across both awaits, cancellation, and unmount.
items.private_solution: Asynchronous responses need a current-request identity guard; types alone do not establish ordering.

items.subject: c
items.title: A published pointer loses its owner

items.goal: Specify a safe reclamation/ownership protocol and an adversarial interleaving test.
items.private_solution: Atomic publication does not preserve the pointee lifetime; reclamation requires coordinated reader ownership.

items.subject: c

items.goal: Check arithmetic, source bounds and allocation failure before copying.
items.private_solution: Multiplication may overflow size_t; validate count against SIZE_MAX/sizeof(Item), capacities and allocation results.

items.title: A vector reference is invalidated

items.goal: Keep references within their valid lifetime.
items.private_solution: reserve that increases capacity invalidates existing element references.

items.subject: cpp

items.goal: Define lifetime reclamation and memory-order assumptions independently.
items.private_solution: Atomic raw-pointer operations do not provide ownership or safe reclamation.

items.goal: Minimize lock lifetime and define which state must be revalidated after the await.

items.subject: embedded-c

items.subject: embedded-python

items.subject: embedded-python

items.private_solution: Asynchronous submission is not transfer completion; a buffer cannot be mutated while the peripheral still owns it.

items.subject: python
items.title: An exit hook masks the original error
items.code:

    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, kind, value, traceback):

items.failure: Code after the with statement runs as though the write succeeded.
items.goal: Preserve operation failures while guaranteeing cleanup.
items.private_solution: A truthy return from __exit__ suppresses the exception passed to it.
